question: Which of the following states has become the first Indian state to accord sports an industry status?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mizoram__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Mizoram Cabinet has become the first Indian state to accord sports an industry status.
 
• This decision is expected to **promote employment generation in the state.**
 
• This was announced by the state’s Chief Minister Zoramthanga.
 
• The Sports and Youth Services department had advised the State government to grant the status.
 
• Mizoram has a good group of Football players who represent several important clubs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Chief Minister of Mizoram- Pu Zoramthanga
 
• Governor- Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati
 
• Mizoram was the first state to decide to grant industry status to sports.
